title: Slimline onramp and rollback orchestration for air-gapped/VPC customers
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently request Private/VPC/on-prem installs but cannot meet our full network upgrade or persistent egress requirements. This leads to long manual engagements and delayed rollouts.

Goal: Define a repeatable, low-risk "slimline onramp" path that lets low-complexity customers get a minimal, auditable connectivity channel for initial provisioning, telemetry collection, and staged patching, plus an orchestrated rollback path for failed upgrades. The outcome should reduce manual intake time, clarify risk buckets, and enable an option for 'temporary proxy bridges' that satisfy air-gapped constraints.

Scope: Non-bug product work focused on intake, prioritization, and triage for network-constrained private deployments. Technical scope includes: connectivity fingerprinting, ephemeral proxy adapter pattern, TLS chain pre-validation, staged delta-patch gating, and rollback orchestration (canary -> partial rollback -> full rollback). Out of scope: changing core runtime kernel selection, writing new cryptographic libraries, or full refactor of Dedicated autoscaling.

Constraints and assumptions: customers can accept a time-limited outbound proxy or allow a signed-connector appliance in a DMZ. Legal must sign off on telemetry retention policy for the slimline path. The approach must preserve customer data isolation guarantees and integrate with our KMS/HSM controls for key material exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Slimline onramp rubric documented in Confluence with clear signals for Accept / Require-Change / Decline
A reference ephemeral-proxy adapter design doc (network topology + cert flow) reviewed by ENG and Security
Two intake playbook templates (low-risk, medium-risk) that Solutions can apply during first-touch
Rollback orchestration runbook with scripted playbook for canary failure -> partial rollback -> full rollback
Telemetry/metric set and dashboard (Console) spec to detect pre/post-upgrade regressions with alert thresholds
decision_notes:
We will offer a temporary, auditable outbound proxy adapter rather than create a permanent new network surface. Trade-offs: faster time-to-value vs longer operational lifecycle for customers who later need full VPC connectivity. For high-risk customers (sensitive data or regulator-mandated airgap) route to full onprem track; do not use slimline onramp. Security requests explicit preflight and a signed SLA amendment. Engineering prefers a connector appliance image for the initial pilot (smaller attack surface) vs. cloud-hosted proxy. We will pilot with 3 customers from Systems Integrator partnerships.

Key follow-ups: (1) ENG to produce adapter PoC by 2026-03-18, (2) Legal to draft slimline amendment template, (3) Solutions to prepare intake scripts and signals checklist.
